description: The endpoint maps claude-* names onto DeepSeek models without saying so: claude-opus-4-1 was served by deepseek-v4-pro (response.model), HTTP 200. lm15 refuses a model outside the endpoint's own prefix (compat model_prefixes) so the caller never gets a silently substituted model. No wire request.

provenance.evidence: api.deepseek.com/anthropic 2026-09-03: receipts/2026-09-03-deepseek-anthropic/discovery-model-claude-opus.json (HTTP 200, model=deepseek-v4-pro for claude-opus-4-1); guide--anthropic-api.md § Anthropic Model Mapping documents the remap; an unknown name is a loud 400 (discovery-model-unknown.json), so only claude-* is silent; changes/2026-09-03-deepseek-anthropic-live.md

canonical_request_provenance.evidence: authored from the discovery/probe cell it pins (research/providers/deepseek-anthropic/); the reference raises at build_request (lm15-python tests/test_registry.py)
